title: Choose the overview's structure
question: The app's look stays (dark, hairlines, Geist, emerald for on). These are three ways to build bellydsp.com inside it. Lock one, steer, or re-roll.

options.label: The record sleeve
options.lineage: a 12-inch LP: front cover, back cover track list, inner-sleeve liner notes
options.thesis: BellyDSP released like a record: the cover is the rig you play, the back is the track list, the inner sleeve is the liner notes.
materials: the app's amp heads as cover art
options.viewport: A square cover on the left holds the live head with its shelf of eight minis; the right is the sleeve's sticker: the name, a one-line hook, and both downloads.
options.risk: The record metaphor can tip into costume if the track list stops being plain, scannable feature copy.

raised.raise: The track list sets one idea per row in hard asymmetry, numbered like tracks, never a grid of equal cards.
The cover's shelf never wraps at any width; it scales, and the playing amp is always lit.

options.label: Material bands
options.lineage: the app's eight head materials, unrolled into the page
options.thesis: The page is the shelf unrolled: each amp owns a full-width band in its own material, and you scroll from Glass to Quartz.
materials: tolex, weave and stone as page-scale fields
the shelf as a sticky index
options.viewport: The shelf of eight minis spans the top as the page's index; below, Glass's silver band fills the screen with its head, its one-line voice, and the download pinned in the bar.
options.risk: Eight material fields are loud; the features and the engineer path must get calm bands of their own or the page becomes a catalog.

options.label: The cable
options.lineage: the app's signal chain, drawn as one patch cable
options.thesis: One signal line runs down the page from Input to Output, and every block is a stop on it, the amp first and largest.
materials: the chain's block chips as stations
the live head at the Amp stop
options.viewport: The cable enters at Input top left and runs into the Amp stop, where the live head and its shelf sit at full size; the download waits in the bar and at Output.
options.risk: A long vertical line can feel like a timeline template; each stop needs its own scale and density to keep the scroll paced.
